title: selectors skips the done tasks and subtasks of an active sprint, and the repro of a bug
goal: Found in the review of SP-qzip6qar, item BG-fyr5ncj5 (selectors ignores done items, so a change that deletes the tests a done item of the active sprint checks is not told before the review): backlog.py selectors counts the tests.py -k selectors of a done task or subtask whose story is in the active sprint (the sprint through bl.sprint_of, not the item's own sprint field) and of a bug's repro, as the sprint review reruns them.
